[Watch Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yYfLHLgAyO4)


## From days to hours: How NAES transformed finance with AI


In this client conversation, Stephanie Sprouse, Chief Finance Officer, NAES, shares how AI is reshaping the CFO role, from operational efficiency to predictive forecasting and stronger financial controls. In discussion with Narasimha Kini, EVP, Banking and Capital Markets & Diversified Industries, EXL, Stephanie highlights real-world examples of AI in action, including dramatic cycle-time reductions in order-to-cash, improved working capital management, and the importance of moving forward even when data isn’t perfect. She also reflects on the value of having EXL as a practitioner-led partner in NAES’s AI transformation journey.


## Our clients’ success is our success


> “They \[EXL\] provide insight from past experiences to help companies move faster through this transformation. It’s really important to have the right partner on this journey.”


Stephanie Sprouse, Chief Finance Officer, NAES
